scientific_integrity: All limits and assumptions are explicit. Direct finite verification complements, rather than substitutes for, the integral-circulation proof. Historical-priority comparisons are same-model and not independent confirmation.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-output, bounded alphabet, unweighted row-deletion setting. To realize repeated (x,y,z) profiles as distinct assignments, use an unconstrained identifier attribute. No assertion for three outputs, weighted teams, or fixed identifier-free schemas. Earlier equivalent formulations in contingency-table or guessing-probability terminology are a residual priority risk.
title: The complete integer joint-error spectrum of two bounded-alphabet functional dependencies
